title: Run a container engine on the evaluation machine
goal: Run a container engine on the evaluation machine
acceptance: Docker Desktop or a CLI engine (colima) runs on the evaluation machine
`docker run --rm --network none alpine true` exits 0 and a network call from such a container fails
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: The commands on the linked page give their expected results
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Added 2026-11-24 after the owner chose containers (F-015-T02): the sandboxed runner needs a running engine. Owner time only.
